english.title: Use words / letters / marks implying authority to collect / receive / sort / deliver postal service
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the authority of the universal service provider, namely **(..SPECIFY PROVIDER..), used in a document relating to

(A)_[yourself]_
(B)_[another person,namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..) ]_
(C)_[a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..)]_
(D)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) , ]_
(E)_[an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..)]_
(F)_[premises, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_

words, letters or marks, namely **(..SPECIFY CHARACTERS..), which signified or implied, or may reasonably have led the public to believe that

(G)_[you were authorised by the universal service provider concerned to collect, receive, sort, deliver or convey]_
(H)_[another person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), was authorised by the universal service provider concerned to collect, receive, sort, deliver or convey]_
(I)_[the ship was used by the universal service provider concerned for the purpose of collecting, receiving, sorting, delivering or conveying of]_
(J)_[the vehicle was used by the universal service provider concerned for the purpose of collecting, receiving, sorting, delivering or conveying of]_

(L)_[the premises were used by the universal service provider concerned for the purpose of collecting, receiving, sorting, delivering or conveying of]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 87(2)(b) and (5) of the Postal Services Act 2000.
